description: She wears a richly layered opaque cream-and-gold floor-length dress with a near-collarbone rounded-square neckline and full wrist-length sleeves beneath a dark charcoal-brown flowing outer robe. Dense gold geometric and floral embroidery edges the neckline, central front bands, robe opening, sleeves and hems. A broad decorated belt has two large circular gold medallions. A dark outer wrap with extensive gold patterned borders covers the shoulders and arms and hangs along the sides. Gold drop earrings, an ornate necklace with hanging pendants and several rings accompany the outfit. One gold-brown embroidered closed-toe shoe is visible; no headgear or weapon appears.
